LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_Chance: Chance of predators targeting each arrival: {0}%
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_FightBack_Tip: When disabled, refugees flee instead of retaliating. Those incapable of violence cannot fight back.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_FollowDifficulty: Outside predators follow difficulty after prey runs out

When enabled, predators without accessible Ratkin prey or corpses seek food normally, following your setting for hunting humans. When disabled, they leave if hungry with no Ratkin food available. Home-area Ratkin and corpses are controlled by the separate setting below.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_SearchInterval_T: Higher values reduce map checks and CPU use but make predators react more slowly.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_AvoidWhenFed: Wild predators avoid Ratkin when fed
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_AvoidWhenFed_Tip: Enabled by default. Predators target Ratkin only below the normal food-seeking threshold; when disabled, an event can make them hunt even while relatively full.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_LeaveAfterFed: Wild predators leave after feeding once
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_LeaveAfterFed_Ti: Disabled by default. When enabled, a predator leaves after successfully eating and reaching its fed threshold; an interrupted hunt does not trigger departure.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_HuntHomeArea: Wild predators hunt Ratkin in the home area
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_HuntHomeArea_Tip: Disabled by default. When enabled, wild predators registered by a Mouse Disaster event may hunt unclaimed Ratkin and eat their corpses inside the player home area.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Predation_Text: A wild predator has begun hunting the arriving Ratkin refugees, favoring their children.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_OutsidePredators_Text: A predator has followed the Ratkin refugees into this area. It is searching for Ratkin prey.
